options.content: Control-plane health for the Coraza Kubernetes Operator. Use **Resource drill-down** (top-right link) for per-CR troubleshooting. Alerts are defined in the Helm `PrometheusRule` when enabled.

panels.title: Engines not ready
panels.description: Recording rule from PrometheusRule. Count of Engines where Ready != True.

panels.title: RuleSets not ready
panels.description: Recording rule from PrometheusRule.

panels.title: RuleSources degraded
panels.description: Recording rule from PrometheusRule. RuleSources in Degraded condition.

panels.title: Reconcile error ratio
panels.description: Ratio of reconcile errors to total reconciles (5m rate).

panels.title: Cache utilization
panels.description: Cache size vs configured maximum.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Recording rule: 200s / (200s + 404s) over 5m. Shows no data when there is no cache traffic.

panels.title: Reconcile rate
panels.description: Reconciles per second by controller and result.

panels.title: RuleSource validation rate
panels.description: RuleSource validations per second by outcome (valid=Coraza parse succeeded, invalid=parse failed, skipped=annotation or patch-only).

panels.title: RuleSet validation rate
panels.description: RuleSet aggregate validations per second (valid=Coraza parse succeeded; does not imply Ready).

panels.title: RuleSource validation duration
panels.description: RuleSource validation latency by outcome.

panels.title: RuleSet validation duration
panels.description: RuleSet aggregate validation latency by outcome.

panels.title: Errors & auth failures
panels.description: Cache server 5xx error rate and authentication failure rate.

panels.title: Cache size vs limit
panels.description: RuleSet cache payload size vs configured maximum (always emitted by the operator).

panels.title: GC prune rate
panels.description: Entries pruned per second by reason (age/size). Flat at zero until GC runs.

panels.title: Cache instances & entries
panels.description: Distinct cache keys and total stored revisions.

panels.title: Cache Put duration
panels.description: Latency of RuleSet cache Put operations after successful validation.

panels.title: API request rate
panels.description: Kubernetes API request rate by verb and resource (from client-go).

panels.title: API errors (non-2xx)
panels.description: Non-success API responses by status code.

panels.title: API request latency p99
panels.description: Kubernetes API call latency by verb.

panels.title: Workqueue retries
panels.description: Workqueue retry rate per controller.

panels.title: Longest running processor
panels.description: Duration of the longest currently-running reconcile per controller.

panels.title: Unfinished work
panels.description: Total seconds of unfinished work in the queue per controller.

panels.title: Engines
panels.description: Current per-namespace engine count (instant; empty when zero).

panels.title: RuleSets
panels.description: Current per-namespace ruleset count (instant; empty when zero).

panels.title: RuleSources
panels.description: Current per-namespace rulesource count (instant; empty when zero).

panels.title: RuleData
panels.description: Current per-namespace ruledata count (instant; empty when zero).
